title: BA1/42/2013 of MOHAMMAD ABID Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and ANOTHER

paras.text:
B.A. 1 No. 42 of 2013
Hon. U.C. Dhyani, J.

Mr. Sanjay Bhatt and Mr. Vivek
Pathak, Advocates for the applicant.
 Ms. Mamta Bisht, A.G.A. for the
State.
 Supplementary affidavit filed on
behalf of the applicant is taken on record.
 Learned counsel for the applicant
prays for and are permitted to withdraw the
bail application at this stage with liberty to
file fresh bail application in due course.
 The bail application is dismissed as
withdrawn.
